title.narrative: Africa Regional (Africa - G5 Sahel: Burkina Faso, Mali, Niger): Programme d’appui intégré aux systèmes de justice pénale du Mali, Burkina Faso et Niger

description.narrative: 1) To strengthen the capacity and performance of the justice sector actors. 2) To increase the capacity of external actors (national human rights institutions, civil society and media) to monitor the activities of the justice sector. 3) To empower the civil society and facilitate their access to justice. 4) To sensitize the criminal justice chain on gender rights and needs.
Justice sector actors, civil society (national and international) and the media.

The project aims to enhance the quality of the criminal justice system in Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger to make it more accessible, respectful of human rights, fast, transparent and focused on the population’s needs.
